The decisive error is in part (1): the sum \(\frac{4}{81}+\frac{4}{81}\) omits the reverse draw orders.

Independently, all qualifying ordered pairs are
\[
(R_1,B_2),\ (B_2,R_1),\ (R_2,B_1),\ (B_1,R_2).
\]
Thus
\[
P=2\left(\frac29\frac29+\frac49\frac19\right)
=\boxed{\frac{16}{81}}.
\]
For example, drawing red \(2\) first and blue \(1\) second satisfies both conditions but was not counted in the submitted calculation.

For part (2),
\[
P(A)=\frac69=\frac23,\qquad P(B)=\frac39=\frac13,
\]
and
\[
P(A\cap B)=\frac29\frac28+\frac49\frac38
=\frac29=P(A)P(B).
\]
Hence \(A\) and \(B\) **are independent**.

**Verified final result:** (1) \(\boxed{16/81}\); (2) \(\boxed{P(A)=2/3,\ P(B)=1/3}\), independent. The submitted part (1), \(8/81\), is too small by a factor of two; part (2) is correct.
